inlines.v: PUTREFAC'TION, noun [Latin putrefactio; putris; putrid, and facio, to make.] A natural process by which animal and vegetable bodies are disorganized and dissolved, or reduced to their original separate elements. putrefaction is greatly accelerated by heat and moisture.
